cleananimations.config.title: Clean Animations
cleananimations.config.empty: No options in this section yet.
cleananimations.config.core.enabled.tool: Master switch for every animation of this mod.
cleananimations.config.core.animationSpe: Global speed multiplier for all animations.
cleananimations.config.core.intensity.to: How strong the animation motion is. 0 disables motion.
cleananimations.config.swing.enabled.too: Master switch for the swing animations. When off, vanilla item animations are used.
cleananimations.config.swing.intensity.t: How far items move and rotate during swings, equip and idle animations.
cleananimations.config.swing.speed.toolt: Speed multiplier for swing, mining and inspect animations.
cleananimations.config.swing.axeSwing.to: Overhead wind-up and heavy chop for axes.
cleananimations.config.swing.pickaxeSwin: Overhead pick swing with a small recoil.
cleananimations.config.swing.hoeSwing.to: Low sideways sweeping motion for hoes.
Quick thrust with a pull-back for spears and tridents.
cleananimations.config.swing.maceSwing.t: Slow raise and heavy smash with a small shake on impact.
Short nudge animation when swinging while holding a block.
cleananimations.config.swing.genericSwin: Fallback swing for every other item.
cleananimations.config.swing.comboEnable: Consecutive attacks within 0.6 seconds cycle through different slash variants.
cleananimations.config.swing.miningAnima: Loops a tool-specific animation while you hold the attack key on a block.
cleananimations.config.swing.equipAnimat: Lowers the old item and raises the new one with a small overshoot when switching.
cleananimations.config.swing.idleBreathi: Subtle breathing motion of the held item.
cleananimations.config.swing.idleSway.to: Gentle sway of the held item while walking and sprinting.
cleananimations.config.swing.inertiaStre: How strongly the held item lags behind when you turn the camera.
cleananimations.config.swing.inspectEnab: Allows spinning and flipping the held item with the inspect key.
cleananimations.config.swing.keepVanilla: Keep Vanilla Swing for Other Items
Blocks and items without a dedicated animation keep the vanilla swing.
cleananimations.config.placement.placeAn: Placed blocks visibly settle into place.
cleananimations.config.placement.style.t: How a placed block moves into place.
cleananimations.config.placement.duratio: Base length of the placement animation before the speed settings are applied.
cleananimations.config.placement.intensi: How far blocks move and scale while being placed or broken.
cleananimations.config.placement.speed.t: Speed multiplier of the placement and break animation.
cleananimations.config.placement.onlyOwn: Animate only blocks you place yourself, not blocks placed by other players or the world.
cleananimations.config.placement.breakAn: Blocks you break shrink and tilt away briefly.
cleananimations.config.placement.easedOu: The selection box glides between blocks instead of snapping.
cleananimations.config.placement.outline: How quickly the selection box follows your aim.
cleananimations.config.placement.precise: WARNING: Places a block immediately on every newly targeted face while use is held, without vanilla's 4 tick delay. Some servers consider this cheating or use anti-cheat that flags it. Use at your own risk.
cleananimations.config.placement.bridgin: WARNING: When you aim into a gap beside the blocks you stand on, using a block places it there anyway (reach-around placement). Some servers consider this cheating or use anti-cheat that flags it. Use at your own risk.
Shows small brackets around the crosshair while the bridging assist has a target.
cleananimations.placement.warning.server: May be considered cheating on some servers.
cleananimations.config.hud.enabled.toolt: Turns every HUD and camera effect of this module on or off.
cleananimations.config.hud.hotbar.toolti: The selection frame glides between slots and the selected slot lifts slightly.
cleananimations.config.hud.hotbarIntensi: Strength of the hotbar lift and bounce.
cleananimations.config.hud.hotbarSpeed.t: How fast the selection frame glides.
The selection frame overshoots slightly before settling.
cleananimations.config.hud.hotbarItemBou: A slot bounces when an item is picked up, used or a block is placed.
cleananimations.config.hud.zoom.tooltip: Hold the zoom key to zoom in with an eased field of view.
cleananimations.config.hud.zoomLevel.too: Zoom factor each time you start zooming.
Highest zoom factor reachable with the scroll wheel.
cleananimations.config.hud.zoomSpeed.too: How fast the zoom eases in and out.
cleananimations.config.hud.zoomScroll.to: While zooming, the mouse wheel changes the zoom level instead of the hotbar slot.
cleananimations.config.hud.zoomScaleSens: Mouse sensitivity shrinks with the zoom so aiming stays precise.
cleananimations.config.hud.crosshair.too: The crosshair pulses when you attack, mine or use items.
cleananimations.config.hud.crosshairSpee: How fast the crosshair pulse settles.
cleananimations.config.hud.crosshairHitM: A short flash around the crosshair when you hit a mob.
cleananimations.config.hud.cameraStrafeR: The view leans slightly into sideways movement (at most 1.5 degrees).
cleananimations.config.hud.cameraLanding: The view nods down briefly when you land.
cleananimations.config.hud.cameraSprintF: A soft field of view widening when you start sprinting. Respects the FOV Effects setting.
cleananimations.config.hud.cameraBobSmoo: Walking view bob fades in and out instead of snapping.
cleananimations.config.hud.cameraSpeed.t: How quickly camera effects react and settle.
cleananimations.config.hud.screenOpen.to: Menus and inventories scale in softly when they open.
cleananimations.config.hud.screenOpenInt: How much the screen scales in.
cleananimations.config.hud.screenOpenSpe: How fast the screen eases in.
